title: Stochastic modes in postquantum classical gravity
summary: We study fluctuations of the metric in the postquantum theory of classical gravity, a covariant theory which couples a classical spacetime with quantum matter fields. Mathematical consistency requires spacetime to evolve stochastically. Starting from the classical-quantum path integral, we linearize around Minkowski space and perform a scalar-vector-tensor decomposition, identifying the stochastic modes: a classical spin-2 field and spin-0 scalar, both diffusing around their respective wave equations.
